title: [PT Run] [WindowWalker] Result view not updating when two windows have same properties
summary: WindowWalker selects the second Explorer result but reportedly does not scroll it into view when multiple windows have similar properties.

judgment.rationale: The issue is a viewport/selection mismatch, not stale window details: the selected second Explorer result is outside the visible list. Reporter confirmed the behavior on 0.73 and 0.86. Current Run code scrolls to the added selection in SuggestionsList_SelectionChanged, so reproduction should determine whether WindowWalker result updates bypass or race that event before proposing a change.
evidence: Original steps use two cmd windows and two Explorer windows with result count set to three; selecting the second Explorer result does not scroll it into view.
Reporter confirmed persistence on 0.73.0 and 0.86.0 after maintainer inquiries.
Current source has an explicit ScrollIntoView on selection change; this does not prove the reported sequence is fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the exact multi-window viewport/selection mismatch and trace ScrollIntoView events.

fix_assessment.rationale: Viewport mismatch is applicable if the old multi-window sequence still reproduces; current explicit scroll handler makes a targeted repro necessary before changing it.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep selected WindowWalker result visible
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: asynchronous WindowWalker result/selection updates can leave the selected index outside the visible list without a corresponding scroll after result changes.
plan: Repeat the supplied multi-window sequence on current stable with three results.
Trace selection-change and list-scroll events as the second Explorer result becomes selected.
If a missing/raced scroll is confirmed, synchronize viewport to selected result and add a same-process multi-window regression test.
verification: The selected second Explorer result is visible after arrow navigation, including when multiple windows share process properties.

confidence.rationale: The issue has concrete steps and current source has a scroll handler, but it is unknown whether result-update timing bypasses that handler.

reproduce.title: Keep selected WindowWalker result visible
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported on 0.73 and 0.86; compare current stable
prerequisites: WindowWalker enabled; two cmd and two Explorer windows
setup: Set maximum result count to three as in the issue.
steps: 1. Open cmd windows titled da and dab and two Explorer windows.
2. Search the windows in PowerToys Run and arrow to the second Explorer result.
3. Check whether the selected result is visible without manual scrolling.
reproduce.expected_result: The selected second Explorer result remains visible in the list as selection changes.
